Usage: actual category-groups [options] [command]

Manage category groups

Options:
  -h, --help             display help for command

Commands:
  list [options]         List category groups (excludes hidden by default)
  create [options]       Create a new category group
  update [options] <id>  Update a category group
  delete [options] <id>  Delete a category group
  help [command]         display help for command
